title: Wind-Burst Mod
description: Adds the Wind Burst Enchantment from Minecraft 1.21 into 1.18.2
body:
Wind Burst – Bring Minecraft 1.21’s Legendary Enchantment to 1.18.2! 🌬️✨

Experience the power of the iconic Wind Burst Enchantment from Minecraft 1.21, now available for Minecraft 1.18.2! This mod adds the epic ability to launch yourself and enemies with every hit, turning combat into an intense, cinematic experience.

Features:

🔹 Wind Burst Enchantment: Add this powerful enchantment to your weapon to unleash explosive wind knockback.

🔹 Multiple Levels: Wind Burst I, II, and III increase both knockback radius and player launch height.

🔹 Player Launch: Propel yourself into the air with each attack for dynamic movement and epic combos.

🔹 Mass Knockback: Push all enemies in range away with a satisfying burst effect.

🔹 Sound & Particles: Immersive sound and visual effects for every strike.

Perfect for players, modpacks, and servers wanting to add a thrilling new combat mechanic to Minecraft 1.18.2.

📌 Installation:

Install Forge for Minecraft 1.18.2.

Download the Wind Burst mod.

Place it in your mods folder.

Launch Minecraft and enjoy!

Unleash the wind and fight like never before! 🌪️
